id: \rI don't dare go out into the Crown Tundra anymore. I heard about a scary Pokémon that lives in it.
en: \rI don't dare go out into the Crown Tundra anymore. I heard about a scary Pokémon that lives in it.
it: \rNon oso più avventurarmi nella Landa Corona. Ho sentito parlare di un Pokémon spaventoso che ci vive.

id: \rDon't stay outside too long. You'll catch a cold.
en: \rDon't stay outside too long. You'll catch a cold.
it: \rNon stare fuori troppo a lungo. Ti prenderai un raffreddore.

id: It's an old statue. The words are impossible to read.
en: It's an old statue. The words are impossible to read.
it: È una vecchia statua. Le scritte sono illeggibili.

id: \bGrowing food out here isn't easy. It's an all day project.
en: \bGrowing food out here isn't easy. It's an all day project.
it: \bColtivare cibo quassù non è facile. Ci vuole tutto il giorno.
